definitions.explanation: The hard tissue forming the skeleton.

examples.japanese: {骨|ほね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧。

examples.english: A fish bone got stuck in my throat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曲|ま}がっている→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。

examples.english: The ribs of the umbrella broke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{骨組|ほねぐ}み→骨組み：06595_honegumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出来上|できあ}がった→出来上がる：10407_dekiagaru⟧。
examples.english: The framework of the building was completed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨|ほね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧だ。
examples.english: The backbone of the story is done, but the details are not yet.

notes:
{骨|ほね} means bone (the body part) and also extends figuratively to mean framework, structure, or the essence of something. It is also used in many idiomatic expressions related to effort and difficulty.

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {傘|かさ}の{骨|ほね}: umbrella ribs
- {話|はなし}の{骨|ほね}: the backbone/framework of a story
- {骨組|ほねぐ}み: framework, structure

EXPRESSIONS:
- {骨|ほね}を{折|お}る: to break a bone; to make great effort
- {骨|ほね}が{折|お}れる: to be laborious, demanding
- {骨抜|ほねぬ}きにする: to remove the backbone; to weaken/water down
- {骨|ほね}のある{人|ひと}: a person with backbone/guts

COMPOUNDS:
- {骨格|こっかく}: skeleton, physique
- {背骨|せぼね}: spine, backbone
- {骨折|こっせつ}: bone fracture
- {魚|さかな}の{骨|ほね}: fish bone
